item.title: Number in man page titles e.g. sleep(3)
item.description:
📝 And there’s more to these numbers than what the man man page describes: various letters can also be attached as suffixes to the numbers. For example, p indicates a POSIX man page like with free(3p) and x indicates X documentation like with ncurses(3x). It’s embarrassing to admit I’ve been using man pages for years but only learned this today.
🔗 Read more: https://lalitm.com/til-number-in-man-page-titles-e-g-sleep-3/
